verdict.rationale: Zep documents hybrid search combining semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search and a scope="auto" mode that composes context dynamically across graph elements, giving developers some control beyond pure vector similarity. However, there is no evidence of explicit metadata filtering options or a reranking step/model in the retrieval pipeline. Missing for 10: metadata filter parameters on search calls, reranking configuration/model support, independent confirmation of these controls in practice.
